task: Reject promoted AEG experiences whose repository-relative evidence files do not exist

subtasks.description: Audit bounded internal consistency candidates without release overlap
lessons: Reject ambiguous version mismatches when components may version independently and release work is excluded.

subtasks.description: Reproduce semantic acceptance of a nonexistent but internally matching evidence path
lessons: Cross-field equality is insufficient provenance validation when both fields can agree on a nonexistent artifact.

subtasks.description: Add repository-confined file resolution for canonical promoted evidence
lessons: Apply repository existence checks to the canonical promoted library without forcing standalone candidate artifacts into the same repository layout.

subtasks.description: Run focused, full Python, schema, result, benchmark, and extension verification
lessons: Use the CI command list rather than bare unittest discovery; root discovery found zero tests because test modules live in non-package directories.

constraints: Change at most three files and no promoted experience, schema, version, or release artifact.
Do not push, publish, promote, or make cross-project/PMF claims.
lessons: Validate that provenance evidence is both internally consistent and resolvable; matching strings can otherwise certify absent files.
Reject absolute and parent-traversing paths before filesystem resolution so evidence cannot escape the repository.
AEG abstained because generic Repair Lab validation overlap scored only 0.0171; no prior record changed the implementation.
A successful internal maintenance pilot improves repository reliability only; it is not independent product-market evidence.

limitations: The category's 30-minute wall-clock target was exceeded, although command/file bounds held.
Evidence existence does not prove evidence truth, freshness, or semantic adequacy.
Filesystem checks run automatically only for the canonical verified library; arbitrary --library candidates retain portable semantic validation.
Bare root unittest discovery ran zero tests, so verification switched to the explicit CI-listed test commands.
npm/AJV installation emitted public transitive deprecation warnings; npm audit for the extension reported zero vulnerabilities.
The original local repair commit SHA is unavailable; patch-hash equivalence with reconstructed commit ab0362955a755ab0353422b6044e5d9d08b6713a does not recover the missing identity.

recommendedFor: hardening a promoted experience library against missing local evidence files
testing semantic provenance beyond cross-field string equality
adding repository-confined validation without breaking portable candidate libraries
